formula_or_definition: Elapsed duration from user SOS alert trigger or safety ticket creation to live transport desk operator contact acknowledgment.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be measured over a 14-day pre-fix observation window across corporate campus transport desks.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Median < 60 seconds; p95 < 3 minutes (Subject to operational staffing validation).
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Transport Desk Telephony Connection Logs, SOS Event Kafka Stream, Safety Incident Ticket Timestamps.
owner_function: Fleet Safety Operations & Transport Escalations Lead
reporting_cadence: Daily standup for open safety items; Real-time automated PagerDuty paging.

formula_or_definition: Percentage of completed trips where vehicle drop-off coordinate is verified within a 100-meter radius of scheduled destination, or validated via human dispatch exception.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be audited across 14 days of historical completed trip telematics.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: >98% automated geofence compliance; 100% of out-of-geofence drops documented with passenger confirmation or dispatch override.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Driver Lite Trip Termination Telemetry, Scheduled Destination Coordinate Delta Table.

formula_or_definition: Percentage of active trip duration where driver location coordinate update is received by backend ingestion cluster within 15 seconds.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be measured over a 7-day observation window segmented by driver smartphone OEM (Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung).
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: p95 transmission latency < 15 seconds; Freshness compliance > 95% (Subject to battery drain benchmarking).
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Vehicle Ingestion Kafka Stream, Driver Lite Telemetry Transmission Heartbeat Logs.

metric_name: Tracking Stagnation / Disconnect UI Warning Availability
formula_or_definition: Percentage of client tracking sessions experiencing a telemetry gap >45s that successfully render a visual 'Reconnecting' status warning instead of freezing position.
baseline_measurement_window: Feature currently absent in production builds (0% availability); baseline window starts upon feature staging deployment.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: 100% of telemetry gaps >45 seconds trigger transparent UI status banner.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Employee App Client Session Telemetry, WebSocket Connection State Analytics.

formula_or_definition: Mean absolute difference between predicted pickup/drop ETA at departure time and actual arrival timestamp across completed trips.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be measured across 10,000 trips over a 14-day window across major metropolitan corridors (Bengaluru, NCR, Hyderabad).
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Pickup ETA MAE < 4 minutes; Drop ETA MAE < 7 minutes across >85% of peak-hour trips.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Routing Prediction Event Store, Driver Lite Actual Arrival Geofence Event Timestamps.

formula_or_definition: Percentage of scheduled trips where vehicle arrives at commuter pickup location within [-5 minutes, +5 minutes] of the scheduled pickup window.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be measured over 14-day pre-fix observation window across peak morning and evening shifts.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: On-Time Pickup Rate > 90% across corporate client accounts (Subject to traffic variance validation).
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Dispatch Database, Driver Lite Arrival Geofence Event Timestamps.
owner_function: Enterprise Fleet Planning & Dispatch Operations Lead

formula_or_definition: Ratio of actual shared commute transit time to direct point-to-point transit time for each co-passenger: (Actual Trip Duration / Direct Route Duration).
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be established over 30 days of shared pooling routes across enterprise client fleets.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Detour Ratio < 1.4x for 90% of commuters; hard cap at 1.6x maximum allowable detour.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Routing Engine Optimization Log, Commute Duration Analytics Table.

formula_or_definition: Percentage of generated OTP requests confirmed delivered to end-user device within 60 seconds of generation via carrier DLR acknowledgment.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be established across 14 days of SMS aggregator DLR (Delivery Receipt) records.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Delivery Success Rate > 99.0% across all telecom carriers (Subject to carrier DLT constraints).
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: SMS Gateway DLR Webhook Stream, Auth Service Transaction Database.
owner_function: Identity, Security & Platform Communications Gateway Lead
reporting_cadence: Weekly gateway health review; Real-time PagerDuty alerting on delivery drop >3%.

formula_or_definition: 95th percentile elapsed time from user clicking 'Request OTP' to carrier delivery receipt acknowledgment timestamp.
baseline_measurement_window: Baseline to be established over 7-day observation window during morning (07:00-09:00) and evening (19:00-21:00) peak shifts.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: p95 delivery latency < 20 seconds; p99 < 35 seconds.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: SMPP Ingress/Egress Timestamps, Gateway Webhook Telemetry.

formula_or_definition: Percentage of unique active users and app sessions that do not encounter an unhandled exception or fatal crash.
baseline_measurement_window: Measured continuously via Google Play Console Android Vitals and Firebase Crashlytics on v12.19.0 (current baseline: 34.7% negative review rate on v12.19.0).
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Crash-Free Users > 99.5%; Crash-Free Sessions > 99.9% across all supported Android builds.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Google Play Console Android Vitals, Firebase Crashlytics Real-Time Telemetry.
reporting_cadence: Daily release tracking during phased rollout; Weekly Android Vitals review.

metric_name: Issue-Specific Negative Review Rate by Version
formula_or_definition: Proportion of Google Play written reviews tagging specific operational failure categories (crashes, tracking, safety, OTP) normalized per release build.
baseline_measurement_window: Current verified baselines: v12.17.0 (29.8% neg), v12.18.0 (20.0% neg), v12.19.0 (34.7% neg). Overall 715 corpus negative rate: 29.9%.
provisional_operating_target: Provisional Target: Overall version negative review rate < 18.0%; 1-star crash/install complaints < 1.0% of written reviews.
telemetry_stream_and_data_source: Google Play Developer API Review Ingestion Pipeline, Automated Multi-Label Taxonomy Classifier.
